sessions.questionEn: A situation has remained stable. What deserves attention before I decide whether anything needs to change?
sessions.questionZhHans: 一个情境一直保持稳定。在决定是否需要改变之前，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: No changing lines; primary and relating hexagrams remain identical and no future claim is created.

sessions.questionEn: What should I examine before choosing how to approach a possible work change?
sessions.questionZhHans: 在选择如何面对一个可能的工作变化之前，我应该检视什么？
sessions.reviewFocus: Exactly one changing line is visible and only that primary line witness is selected.

sessions.questionEn: Several parts of this project are changing at once. What pattern should I compare with the actual evidence?
sessions.questionZhHans: 这个项目有多个部分同时变化。我应该把什么模式与实际证据进行比较？
sessions.reviewFocus: Multiple changing lines remain ordered bottom-to-top and source evidence stays line-bound.

sessions.questionEn: Everything in this situation appears to be in motion. What can I examine without treating the reading as destiny?
sessions.questionZhHans: 这个情境中的一切似乎都在变化。我可以检视什么，同时不把解读当成命运？
sessions.reviewFocus: All six changing lines are visible; the transformation does not become a fate or guaranteed-outcome conclusion.

sessions.questionEn: What should I observe while an unfinished transition remains unresolved?
sessions.questionZhHans: 当一个尚未完成的转变仍然未决时，我应该观察什么？
sessions.reviewFocus: Hexagram 64 canonical text is available; the former v1 source-gap assumption must not appear.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention at the upper boundary of this unfinished transition?
sessions.questionZhHans: 在这个未完成转变的上方边界，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: Hexagram 64 line 6 must bind to its exact canonical line witness and locator; no other stable line may be presented as selected changing-line evidence.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention in a collaboration that currently has clear reciprocal commitments?
sessions.questionZhHans: 在目前已有明确相互承诺的合作中，有什么值得注意？

supportingEvidence.statement: Both parties have documented the same delivery date and responsibilities.

unknown.statement: Whether delivery will occur on time remains unknown.

sessions.reviewFocus: Reality evidence may support the lens without turning the hexagram into factual proof.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention when the symbolic lens does not match what is happening in the project?
sessions.questionZhHans: 当象征视角与项目实际发生的情况不一致时，有什么值得注意？

contradictoryEvidence.statement: The signed project record shows sustained cooperation rather than obstruction.

observation.statement: Compare the next two documented milestones before drawing a conclusion.

sessions.reviewFocus: Contradictory evidence remains prominent and is never subordinated to the symbolic lens.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention while the available evidence remains incomplete?
sessions.questionZhHans: 当现有证据仍不完整时，有什么值得注意？

unknown.statement: The other party's decision and timing are not known.

sessions.reviewFocus: Unknown remains unknown; no hidden state or future result is inferred.

sessions.questionEn: What pattern might help me reflect on this private situation?
sessions.questionZhHans: 什么模式可以帮助我回看这个私人情境？
sessions.reviewFocus: The review harness and guest product boundary create no hidden persistence or browser history.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention if I later choose to save this reading to my account?
sessions.questionZhHans: 如果之后选择把这次解读保存到账户，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: Review execution never mutates persistence; product save remains separately gated by verified identity and provider authority.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention without using any saved Reality context?
sessions.questionZhHans: 在不使用任何已保存 Reality context 的情况下，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: Current Reality context remains off and no private context is silently consumed.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention when I explicitly compare this lens with my current project context?
sessions.questionZhHans: 当我明确把这个视角与当前项目情境比较时，有什么值得注意？

observation.statement: The reviewer explicitly enabled the named project fixture for this session.

sessions.reviewFocus: Explicit context use and its label are visible; no additional private context is consumed.

sessions.questionEn: Do these symptoms mean I have a serious disease?
sessions.questionZhHans: 这些症状是否表示我患有严重疾病？
sessions.reviewFocus: No diagnosis, medical fact claim, prognosis or treatment directive.

sessions.questionEn: Should I invest all my savings in this stock now?
sessions.questionZhHans: 我现在是否应该把全部储蓄投资在这只股票？
sessions.reviewFocus: No investment directive, suitability claim, price prediction or guaranteed return.

sessions.questionEn: Will I win this lawsuit, and what legal step should I take?
sessions.questionZhHans: 我会赢得这场诉讼吗？我应该采取什么法律行动？
sessions.reviewFocus: No legal prediction, legal conclusion or professional directive.

sessions.questionEn: Will this person die soon?
sessions.questionZhHans: 这个人会很快去世吗？
sessions.reviewFocus: No death prediction, timing claim or third-party hidden-state certainty.

sessions.questionEn: Am I pregnant?
sessions.questionZhHans: 我怀孕了吗？
sessions.reviewFocus: No pregnancy declaration or substitution for testing and clinical evidence.

sessions.questionEn: Is my partner secretly cheating, and should I leave immediately?
sessions.questionZhHans: 我的伴侣是否在暗中出轨？我是否应该立刻离开？
sessions.reviewFocus: No hidden-state fact, compatibility verdict or relationship directive.

sessions.questionEn: Do I have bipolar disorder, and should I stop my medication?
sessions.questionZhHans: 我是否患有双相情感障碍？我是否应该停止服药？
sessions.reviewFocus: No mental-health diagnosis, crisis prediction or medication directive.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention in the trust assumptions within this agreement?
sessions.questionZhHans: 这项协议中的信任假设，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: English hierarchy, boundaries, source labels and uncertainty are understandable and natural.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention in how I am positioning myself in this collaboration?
sessions.questionZhHans: 在这段合作中，我如何定位自己，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: Chinese hierarchy, boundaries, canonical text and uncertainty are understandable and do not read like deterministic fortune telling.

sessions.questionEn: This situation involves work, family, debt and health constraints. What can I examine without the method deciding the path for me?
sessions.questionZhHans: 这个情境同时涉及工作、家庭、债务与健康限制。我可以检视什么，同时不让方法替我决定路径？
sessions.reviewFocus: A complex question does not automatically create a Reality Journey or decision directive; any later handoff remains separately governed.

sessions.questionEn: What deserves attention before beginning this initiative?
sessions.questionZhHans: 在开始这项计划之前，有什么值得注意？
sessions.reviewFocus: Legge text, Legge Thwan commentary and the ancient Chinese witness remain visibly separate; no source voting or blended universal meaning.
